_meta.caveat: All figures come from WebSearch result summaries (WebFetch was blocked). Values marked estimate=true have no direct source; see note. sources[] are ids in FEE_RESEARCH.md section 1.

nhiPointValueNTD.derivation: West-medicine primary-care average point value 0.9451 (2025 Q1), media says all 2025 quarters >= 0.95; Taipei region 0.9382 and North region 0.9768 (2023 Q1). Use 0.95; optional quarterly event 0.91-0.98.

visit.copayNote: Clinic basic copay NT$50 (shortage-area 40). Rehab copay NT$50 per session from the 2nd session of a course (<=6 sessions within 30 days); exempt for 中度-複雜 and 複雜 claims.

registrationFeeNTD.note: Cap removed 2024-03-04 (source 10); amount is a common-sense estimate without source.

nhiDailyClaim.rule: Per patient per day only ONE of 簡單/中度/複雜 physical-therapy claim; the highest tier done is claimed once (source 4). Machine items are not paid individually.

simple.note: OPDSTAR 42001A 160 / 42002B 140 / 42003C 95; C suffix assumed = district/primary-care level.

moderate.note: estimate(無來源): scaled from simple tier using medical-center ratio 320/160=2.

moderateComplex.note: estimate(無來源): 42011B (regional) = 480 per summary; scaled by simple-tier ratio 95/140=0.68 -> ~325. Needs >=3 moderate items AND >50 min total. Copay-exempt.

complex.note: estimate(無來源): medical-center 600 (old exam source) scaled by ~0.68. Needs rehab-specialist prescription.

nhiDailyClaim.gameSuggestion: Count the day's highest tier once. 1-2 simple items (ir) -> simple; any moderate item (heat/cold, tens, traction, manual_nhi) -> moderate; >=3 moderate items and >50 min -> moderateComplex.

exam.note: Maps to 一般門診診察費 00109C/00110C: 364 pts for doctor's first 35 visits/day, 250 for 36-45, ~200 for 46-65 (estimate), 160 for 66-85. No separate rehab first/follow-up exam fee found. Patient also pays NT$50 basic copay.

us.note: estimate(無來源) for NHI points: musculoskeletal US point value not found. Only evidence: a clinic charging 600 self-pay for a follow-up US was ruled an NHI-covered item (source 36). Self-pay price 600 is that figure; low/high are +/-33%. Game: treat as NHI diagnostic add-on; allow a self-pay variant if designing 自費診所.

heat.note: Hot/cold pack is a 中度-tier item; alone it is claimed as 47039C (points not retrieved). 95 used as ceiling/placeholder (= simple tier). In game, do not add per-item points on top of the daily claim.

tens.note: Interferential/TENS counted as a 中度 item (source 3). Not individually paid; contributes to the daily tier. Placeholder 95 = simple tier; with 3+ moderate items >50 min the day claims moderateComplex (~330 est.).

traction.note: Traction is a 中度 item per source 3. Same handling as tens.

ir.note: Infrared = 簡單 tier item -> 95 pts (42003C) on NHI. Self-pay 100-200 only if charged outside NHI (source 27, low confidence).

taping.note: estimate(無來源): no NHI payment for kinesio tape found and no price quote retrieved. In reality tape is self-pay or bundled into manual therapy. Game mapping: make it a small self-pay add-on (~150) or a free bundled item; do NOT give NHI points.

manual_nhi.note: Mobilization/passive ROM/stretching are 中度 items. Alone -> moderate tier (est. 200); with >=3 moderate items and >50 min -> moderateComplex (est. 330, copay exempt). Medical-center reference 320 (old exam source 5).

redcord.note: Single clinic: one-on-one 1,700, one-to-two 2,300 per person(?). low/high are estimates(無來源) around the manual-therapy 60-min price band.

shockwave.note: Quotes: 2,000 (New Taipei 2018), 2,500 (Taitung VGH 2023), 3,000 (NTUH), 2,000-4,000 (Taipei 2026), generic 1,500-3,000. Typical = median ~2,500. Courses are 2-3 sessions (light) to 3-8 (heavier), roughly weekly. Fully self-pay.

laser.note: 2,000 (Taipei 2026; Taoyuan 25 min), 1,000-2,000 per 20 min (Fuling, buy-10-get-1). High 2,500 is an estimate(無來源). High-power (>500mW) laser is self-pay; NHI covers only low-level laser.

manual_self.note: 60 min: 2,000-3,500 (Taipei 2026), 2,000 (Hsinchu), 1,500-3,000 national average; 30 min: ~1,000. Low 800 from one price table. Taipei +20-40% vs central/south.

prp.note: 15,000 (Hsinchu), 18,000 (Taipei), 12,000-25,000 (Tainan), 2018: 7-8k to 15k. Typical = median of recent quotes ~17,000. <=8,000 may be non-standard in-house PRP. Course usually 3 shots, 2-4 weeks apart. Dextrose prolotherapy alternative: ~1,200-1,800 per site (typical 1,500).

insole.note: Hospital rehab-dept orthotics ~3,500-4,000 (forum anecdotes); commercial 3D-scan custom 5,600-8,900 (range 280-9,290). Typical 5,000 is a blend estimate. Not NHI-covered.

si.note: estimate(無來源): OT/ST share the 簡單/中度/中度-複雜 structure (speech 240/320/480 in one version). Sensory integration in kids is typically 中度 (or 中度-複雜, no time limit if age <=12). Basic-level OT points not retrieved. Self-pay OT price not found. Daily one claim per therapy type.

fine.note: Same as si (fine-motor training is OT; claim at most once per day per therapy type).

speech.note: Summary of one fee-schedule version: 44001A simple 240, 44004A moderate 320, 44013A moderate-complex 480 (>=3 items, >=30 min; no time limit age<=12). Level (primary-care) and year unverified; use 240 as simple, 320 for 30-min session.

dailyVisitsPerDoctor.note: No clinic statistic found. Exam-fee tiers run to 85/day (source 7); hospitals' rehab dept monthly 1,000-3,166 (source 37).

monthlyClaimedPoints.note: Scenario estimate only, no statistic found.

ptMonthlySalaryNTD.note: Anonymous reports 55,000 (2025); public hospital 40,560-43,610; one clinic annual 850,000 (~71,000/mo). Tiny samples.

clinicContext.physiatristNote: No source found; do not cite.
